name: Burning Hands

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Self-origin 15-foot cone; DEX half 3d6 Fire; higher slots add 1d6; ignite eligible unworn/uncarried flammable objects.

rules.text: A thin sheet of flames shoots forth from you.
Each creature in a 15-foot Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
Flammable objects in the Cone that aren’t being worn or carried start burning.
The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.
